title: Six coder tests fail on main: runtime selection, evidence_select, program_run
body:
Several agents on 2026-09-30/10-01 found these failing on `main` independent of their changes:

- `runtime::tests::a_selection_is_held_to_the_offered_programs` (gets `door_unavailable` where it expects `no_program_chosen`)
- `evidence_select` (1 test)
- `program_run` (4 tests)

Likely related to the Jev/decision door changes (#10048 5710e1311c, #10064 5ed35bf130), where a test that expected a local stand-in now resolves a hosted door or none. Find the cause, fix the code or the tests (whichever is wrong; don't weaken a real check), and make `cargo test -p coder` green. Tests must never reach live services unless opt-in.
